notes.title: Small Hotfix
notes.notes:
Hey Mechanics!

We’ve just rolled out a hotfix update to address some issues and improve your experience in Rally Mechanic Simulator! 

[u][b]🛠️ Fixes & Improvements:[/b][/u][list]
[*] Fixed dismantled visualization for Cylinder Head Type B V2
[*] Added missing icon for Cylinder Head Type B V2 part set
[*] Fixed a bug with car visualization in test mode when using the paint station & paint room
[*] Corrected brake caliper names in French translation
[*] Updated slideshow texts for the diagnostic pathway
[/list]

As always, thanks for your feedback - it helps us keep improving the game! Let us know if you run into any more issues, and happy wrenching! 🚗🔥

notes.title: Small Hotfix
notes.notes:
Hey Mechanics! 👋

We’ve prepared another round of fixes for you! Thanks to your reports, we’ve been able to address several issues. Here’s what’s included in the latest hotfix:

[u]Fixes:[/u][list]
[*] Fixed a bug with the disassembly of Turbo Type A V2 (Boxer).
[*] Resolved an issue when selling cars in the zoom camera view.
[*] Addressed a problem where multiple cars could spawn on a single garage space.
[*] Fixed a bug with marking and selling parts directly from the inventory.
[*] Resolved an issue that allowed a car selected for a rally to spawn unintentionally.
[*] Fixed a problem causing the suspension replacement task to fail.
[*] Corrected a bug where the Ignition Coil Type A (Boxer) fault would trigger multiple times.
[*] Fixed an issue with the rally UI being incorrectly displayed in the tent.
[/list]


Thank you for your support and all the reports! As always, we’re looking forward to your feedback.

notes.title: Hotfix: Version 1.0.167
notes.notes:
Hello Mechanics! 👋

We’ve just released a new hotfix! A big thank you to all of you for sharing your feedback and helping us improve the game. Here’s what’s new and fixed in this update:

[b][u]Changes & Improvements:[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] Added info when wheels can't be mounted because they are unbalanced.
[*] Reduced the maximum offset of the moving exam tool during its animation.
[*] Changed the logic so rally events are no longer blocked when door trims are unmounted.
[/list]
[b][u]Fixes:[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed incorrect loading and setting of parts data when changing the side of brake sets.
[*] Fixed incorrectly assigned screws in front brake mk-3 and mk-2 sets.
[*] Fixed wrongly assigned parameters to screws in mk-4 brake set.
[*] Fixed improperly set exhaust in Purdo 276.
[*] Fixed incorrect extra events state when the player has two cars in the garage.
[*] Fixed naming conventions for some part types with multiple versions in the game.
[/list]

Keep sharing your thoughts and feedback - they’re incredibly valuable in shaping the game’s future.
Thanks for being with us, and happy wrenching! 🚗🛠️
